name: Alert Box Block – Grab Attention with Eye-Catching Notices
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Make important messages impossible to miss – add clean, customizable alert and notice boxes to any post or page, right from the Gutenberg editor.

Live Demo

Why Alert Box Block?

Warnings, tips, updates, and announcements deserve more than plain paragraphs. Alert Box Block lets you create and display notices and alerts on any page using a native Gutenberg block, so key information stands out exactly where readers need it.

The block ships with multiple alert types you can switch between in a click, plus ready-to-use presets that look great without any modification. When you want full control, a rich set of customization options in the block sidebar lets you design the alert box exactly the way you want – improving the user experience of your website with zero code.

Free Features

  • Fully Customizable: Lots of options available to make the alert box look exactly the way you want.
  • Different Alert Types: Switch between multiple alert box types with a single click.
  • Standard Presets: Ready-made alert/notice styles you can use without any modification.
  • Native Gutenberg Block: Works right inside the block editor – no shortcodes or page builders required.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Alert Box Block plugin.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, add the Alert Box Block from the “Widgets” block category.
  3. Adjust the alert type, presets, and styling from the right-side settings sidebar.
  4. Publish – your notice is live. Enjoy!

For installation help, see the Installation tab.

Use Cases

  • Site Announcements: Highlight maintenance windows, launches, or policy updates.
  • Content Warnings & Tips: Add info, success, warning, or error style notices inside tutorials and docs.
  • Promotions: Draw attention to discounts, deadlines, and limited-time offers.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Alert Box Block”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Add the Alert Box Block to any post or page from the Gutenberg editor.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file and upload the folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or upload the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the block from the Gutenberg editor and start customizing.
sections.faq:
Is Alert Box Block free?

Yes, Alert Box Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change the block settings?

Yes, you can change all block settings from the Gutenberg editor’s right-side settings sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

There is no limit – you can use the block as many times as you want, on as many pages as you want.

Can I create different types of alerts?

Yes. The block comes with different alert types, and you can easily switch between them. Ready-made presets are also included so you can add a polished notice without any customization.

Can visitors dismiss an alert box?

Yes, alerts can be shown with or without a dismiss option, so you can decide whether visitors are able to close the notice.

Do I need to know how to code to use this plugin?

No. Everything is configured visually inside the Gutenberg editor – no coding required.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
